slice: Natural conversation round 9: don't hallucinate real-time data

real_llm_before_fix.what's the latest price of bitcoin?: Bitcoin's around $67,000 right now, give or take...

real_llm_after_fix.what's the latest price of bitcoin?: I can't pull live market data right now — I'm offline on that front...

mechanism: detect real-time-data questions (live prices/weather/news/scores); a prompt steer + honest fallback stop Novi from inventing current numbers, while settled historical facts are still answered
